The monthly write-ups singled out Mary Hill for detached houses in June, July, August, October (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in June, August (a buyers’ best bet).
Mary Hill share of Port Coquitlam listings and sales by month

In Mary Hill, its share of the houses listed in Port Coquitlam went from 8.1% in June to 7.3% in October and its share of the condos and townhomes listed went from 1.7% to 1.8%. A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

blocks.text: Mary Hill home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

26 houses sold in Mary Hill with a median price of $1,305,000 (the middle half sold between $1,231,250 and $1,363,250), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 96.7% of the last list price; 15% sold above list. They had a median $537 per square foot, a median year built of 1971 and a median lot of 7,444 square feet. 7 townhomes sold in Mary Hill with a median price of $860,000, taking a median of 11 days to sell at 98.1% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $514 per square foot, a median year built of 1994 and a median strata fee of $398 a month.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Mary Hill?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 10 houses and 4 condos and townhomes listed in Mary Hill. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Mary Hill a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 30% (a sellers’ market); condos and townhomes had 50% on only 4 listed, too few to read as a market type. The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Mary Hill from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 12 houses and 4 condos and townhomes sold in Mary Hill over those 5 months; detached houses peaked in June with 3 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in October with 2 sold.

faq.q: How big is Mary Hill compared with the rest of Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In October 2026, Mary Hill held 7.3% of the 137 detached houses listed in Port Coquitlam and 1.8% of the 219 condos and townhomes listed in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Mary Hill?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses made up 71.4% of the 14 homes listed in Mary Hill and condos and townhomes made up 28.6%; of the 5 that sold, houses were 60.0% and condos and townhomes 40.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Mary Hill than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 14 in June to 10 in October 2026 (−28.6%); condos and townhomes was little changed, 4 in June and 4 in October 2026 (+0.0%).

faq.q: What did houses in Mary Hill sell for?
faq.a: 26 houses sold in Mary Hill between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,305,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Mary Hill?
faq.a: The median was 18 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.7% of the last list price (15% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
